At scale m at most (4/9)^m unspecified positions; since gcd(4,9^m)=1 the same density bound holds on the needed 4k+c progressions. Every factor frequency exists, and the nine-residue recurrence reduces length >=3 factors to shorter ones, with F(1)=2/5 and base pairs F(00)=F(01)=F(10)=3/10, F(11)=1/10. Run tuples correspond exactly to boundary words 1 0^(a1-1) 1 ... and conditional frequency (5/2)F(boundary word). This gives rational all-pattern recursion; exact rational recomputation verified every entry of the /108 matrix and 120000 direct reconstructed Toeplitz symbols. The existence of Toeplitz premise is sourced, not claimed proved ab initio by finite prefix.
